details.name: MSNNow (discontinued social provider)
details.who: All Firefox users who have this add-on installed.
details.why: As part of their ongoing work to fine-tune their editorial mix, msnNOW has decided that msnNOW will stop publishing on Dec. 3, 2013. Rather than having a single home for trending content, they will continue integrating that material throughout all MSN channels. A big thank you to everyone who followed msnNOW stories using the Firefox sidebar
